description: Custom-domain email providers ranked by two-year cost for a number of mailboxes: free forwarding (Cloudflare, ImprovMX), cheap mailboxes (Purelymail, Zoho, Migadu, iCloud+, Namecheap, Hostinger), office suites (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho Workplace) and encrypted options (Proton). Includes intro-price traps and per-user vs flat pricing. Prices are curated from each provider’s pricing page with a date.

need.description: forward = forward to an existing inbox; mailbox = a real inbox (default); suite = mail + calendar + docs; private = end-to-end encrypted.
